title: The service runs from its own install folder, apart from the project checkout
goal: NERV runs from a dedicated checkout (default ~/.nerv-app) that only the lifecycle update touches; ~/Projects/NERV/NERV becomes an ordinary development checkout
acceptance: Lifecycle install/update take the install folder as their source; the service definition points there
A one-time migration clones the installed revision into the install folder, builds it, re-registers the service there and keeps ~/.nerv data unchanged, with a recorded rollback to the old path
The AGENTS.md project line about the primary checkout names the install folder instead
Test across the join: rendered service definition, lifecycle plan and migration use the same install path
privacy: Neutral fixtures only; no personal data.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-23 at agent speed; migration of a live service. Not a measurement.
